meta.title: Training Props & Accessories
meta.description: TZJ offers nearly unlimited fire training props and accessories: heat and smoke, egress, search and rescue, confined space, forcible entry, ventilation, rope rescue, maritime, and hazmat training.

hero.title: Props and accessories for more realistic training
hero.description: Beyond safety, the most important element of live-fire training is creating a dynamic, realistic learning environment. TZJ's extensive props and accessories help you build the training simulators you need.

overview.title: Available training props and accessories
overview.description: From breach points to balconies, attics to elevator shafts — TZJ's design options, fixtures, infrastructure, and props are virtually limitless.

features.title: Hazmat
features.desc: Grant-eligible props or hazmat instructor trailer series: chlorine cylinders, leaking/reaction drums, bulk tank leaks, falling cylinders, control panels, and more.

features.title: Heat & Smoke
features.desc: Class A/B burn props, Class A burn stands, smoke distribution, LED digital fire for extinguisher training, temperature monitoring, and audible/visual alarm systems.

features.title: Egress
features.desc: Straight and L-shaped stairs with landings; ship's ladders, cage ladders, ship ladders, gooseneck ladders; floor hatches, windows, roof scuttles — fully welded hot-dip galvanized.

features.title: Search & Rescue
features.desc: Maze panel systems (no tracks, freely reconfigurable); five balcony designs; Nance and Denver rescue drills.

features.title: Confined Space
features.desc: Manholes, corrugated culverts, elevator shafts, and other confined-space training structures.

features.title: Forcible Entry & Shoring
features.desc: Training for floors, ceilings, windows (including VES), doors (including roll-up doors), roofs, walls, and safety covers.

features.title: Ventilation & Smoke Exhaust
features.desc: Roof and sidewall exhaust fans; custom systems; sloped and flat roof configurations (high-rise, parapet concrete, metal, tile, and more).

features.title: Rope & High-Angle Rescue
features.desc: Code-compliant swivel rope descent devices; platforms, anchor points, guardrails, helicopter skid props, and climbing walls.

features.title: Building Facades
features.desc: Mortar-free and panel brick facades; steel facades; multiple colors and styles available.

features.title: Standpipes / Sprinklers
features.desc: Dry standpipes with FDC connections; dual-head sprinkler systems.

maritime.title: Train for offshore firefighting
maritime.description: Ship fires differ fundamentally from residential and commercial building fires — firefighters often enter at the hottest point and work downward. Real maritime training cannot happen in a classroom alone. TZJ maritime training facilities deliver the look and feel of real vessels.
maritime.lead: We provide extensive props to realistically simulate shipboard firefighting:
features: Full-loop protection systems with isolation valves
Cargo/storage compartments, doors, and porthole props

tactical.title: Training facilities built for tactical forces
tactical.description: Tactical response requires a highly specialized skill set. Modular systems with all-galvanized steel frames and no interior load-bearing walls allow walls, doors, and windows to be moved and reconfigured — ideal for diverse tactical scenarios.

hazmat.title: Prepare for the worst-case scenario
hazmat.description: TZJ also excels in hazardous materials and waste training. We use props and simulators that replicate community hazard scenarios to prepare all types of emergency response — products may qualify for grants and support cross-regional coordination.

products.name: Chlorine cylinder
products.desc: Full-size chlorine cylinder; controllable valve, pipe, and manifold leaks.

products.name: Leaking drum
products.desc: Standard oil drum; simulates forklift puncture, bung, or seam leaks.

products.name: Bulk tank leak
products.desc: Control flammable liquid leaks; valve, manifold, and tank rupture scenarios.

products.name: Reaction drum
products.desc: Bubbling/gurgling sounds and drum vibration; bulging drum top signals rising pressure.

products.name: Falling cylinder
products.desc: Rack failure; uncontrolled release from failed cylinders and manifolds.

products.name: Control panel
products.desc: Handheld tablet to manage all props; emergency stop, pause, and reset.
